描述_EN: although cloisonné was known in china in the fourteenth century, fifteenth-century pieces, such as this dish, are the earliest preserved examples. in fifteenth-century examples, this background color is often combined with shades of red, yellow, cobalt blue, white, and dark green, which were not mixed but placed individually within each cloison. lively scrolling lotuses and acanthus leaves are set against a turquoise blue background on the interior (and parts of the exterior) of this dish.
描述_ZN: 虽然景泰蓝在十四世纪就已经在中国出现，但十五世纪的作品，如这个盘子，是保存下来的最早的例子。 在十五世纪的例子中，这种背景颜色经常与红色、黄色、钴蓝、白色和深绿色的色调结合在一起，这些颜色不是混合的，而是单独放在每个景泰蓝中。 这只盘子的内部（和部分外部）有活泼的卷轴莲花和刺桐叶，衬托着青绿色的背景。
